blocks.text: You cannot survive what you destroy.

Y = 2 AE / (A + E)

Your score is the harmonic mean of the Agent’s net value and the health of Everything not the agent.

A proposed reward design for sustainable agents to calculate moral behavior the way nature already does.  AI today is trained to complete tasks, and its score says nothing about the damage it does getting there.  The Golden Directive puts the world inside the score, so taking from the whole destroys the agent's own score (Y).
